datasets.description: The datasets array defines groups of files, where the files within each dataset reference the same entities (cells, genes, cell sets, etc).

color.description: The color to use when rendering this channel under the null colormap.

selection.description: Determines the channel selection, e.g. some Z and time slice.

slider.description: Determines the range for color mapping.

visible.description: Determines whether this channel of the layer will be rendered in the spatial component.

items.description: One of R G or B (0 - 255).

anyOf.description: Determines the color to be set to opacity 0

transparentColor.description: Determines the color to be set to opacity 0

index.description: The index of the layer among the array of layers available in the image file.

domainType.description: Determines the extent of the channel slider input element in the layer controller.

visible.description: Determines whether this entire layer will be rendered in the spatial component.

items.description: The properties of this object are the rendering settings for the raster layer.

coordinationSpace.description: The coordination space stores the values for each scope of each coordination object.

uid.description: A unique identifier for the view, to refer to it in getter and setter functions in object-oriented contexts.

component.description: Specify a component using a name defined in the component registry.

props.description: Extra prop values for the component.

coordinationValues.description: Mapping from coordination types to values, for values which do not need to be coordinated with other views. These take precedence over coordinationScopes.

layout.description: The layout array defines the views, or components, rendered in the grid.

initStrategy.description: The initialization strategy determines how missing coordination objects and coordination scope mappings are initially filled in.
